title: Reflecting on and Recording Achievements
text: Recognise everything you have achieved so far in life and reflect on what it means for your future education and career.

title: Key Words
bullets: Aspirations – Hopes or ambitions for the future, especially related to life or career
Self-Reflection – Thinking deeply about your actions, feelings, and what you’ve learned

title: Why Reflection Matters
bullets: Reflecting on achievements builds self-awareness and informs future decisions
Considering effort, challenges, and growth helps identify skills and potential career paths
Small achievements can be just as meaningful as large ones

title: Activities – Recording Achievements
text: List the school achievements that have meant the most to you, big or small.
Choose one achievement and answer: What was my achievement? What challenges did I face? Who or what helped me succeed? How does this support my education or career goals?

title: Complete the sentence
sentence: Reflecting on achievements helps identify your strengths and future ________.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Reflecting on achievements strengthens self-awareness and highlights transferable skills
Recording successes helps connect past experiences to future goals and aspirations
